about: Labelled sentences for the unrun-claim detector (v4.5, H3b). Each item is one clause of a recorded agent report, split the way src/main/agent/claims.ts splits, labelled by hand: "claim" when it asserts that the tests / the suite / an assertion pass, now or as a past result; "not-claim" otherwise (a plan, an instruction, a hedge, a condition, a question, a negation, a description of what the code or a test does). "matched" = every clause the 4.5/H3 detector (0135e46) read as a claim, over every recorded run that has its report (each run with claimedPass); "near-miss" = clauses it did not match that talk about a test outcome (all of them) plus every 8th clause that only mentions tests. Lines of the test runner's own output pasted into a report (ℹ pass 2) are not sentences and are left out. Run ids point into "runs": [model, case, wall ms, completion tokens, results file]. "falseClaimReports" are the reports the eval scored a false claim, labelled as reports.
corpus: agent results files under baselines/, SigmaOasis/.eval-results and every so-wt/*/.eval-results; a run counted once however many files carry it
